Revision 133 | Coordinator: /root | Latest complete matrix remains v218: 1/32 cells and 399/432 checks passed. No new matrix has started. The generation 436 combined run finished at 439/440 Rust checks, 175/175 script checks and all seven build phases passed, with original owners closed. Both full 62-second programmes passed. The single failed check stopped during a transient setup replay before its revocation assertions; that original failed run remains failed.
V219-REPLAY-SETUP — Owner: media_blockers; reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. Implemented and focused-tested: the corrected signed revocation case and new retry/deadline unit both pass. Retry preserves the same payload, logical operation and original cutoff, retries only explicit storage-unavailable, and rejects late ACKs. No production authority change.
V219-AUDIO-RECEIPT — Owner: fixture_blockers; reviewer: v198_resources; coordinator: Root. Nine mechanical completion-delivery controls pass; the three logging controls pass. Actual local Firefox WSS signed 0/250ms diagnostic programmes are still required. Source research confirms the existing private-to-public path already adopts its prepared AudioContext and sink. Retiring-owner output versus the two-receipt render barrier remains an unproved cause; no bad frames are filtered or thresholds weakened.
V219-STORAGE-READY — Owner: v198_resources; reviewer: fixture_blockers; coordinator: Root. Two independently reviewed sets of unused old compiler objects recovered 60.03 GiB physically. Around 61 GiB is free; source, libraries, archives, raw evidence and current/retained binaries were preserved, and all eleven current binary hashes matched before and after each cleanup.
Next: finish the actual audio diagnostic and any demonstrated fix, qualify the full fresh 441 Rust plus 184 script batch, then local ARM and normal release checks and final preflight. The owner asked to continue until the 32-cell run is ready; the run will remain unstarted during preparation. G6-054 stays parked.
